scope.question_pairing: Five English-Korean pairs compare the same question meanings.
scope.gold_isolation: Gold answers and Gold evidence are not loaded by the container execution script.

selection_policy.papers: Three verified benchmark papers covering summarization, CPU INT8 inference, and continual anomaly detection.
selection_policy.questions: Five pre-existing bilingual pairs covering paper focus, problem, method, trade-off, and conclusion.
selection_policy.pdf_stress: The set includes two short PDFs and the largest verified benchmark PDF.
